review.notes: Machine-drafted by an AI model; awaiting native-speaker review. House style: moderate Bokmål with three genders (ei/-a for feminine nouns, en/-en masculine, et/-et neuter), weak past in -et, neuter definite plural in -ene, sju and tjue, "ble", "ga". "Gratulerer med dagen" is the fixed birthday greeting; "Gratulerer med bursdagen" is also correct.

sentences.text: I dag har Nils bursdag. Det er en stor bursdag, for han er elleve år.
sentences.english: Today it is Nils's birthday. It is a big birthday, for he is eleven years old.

sentences.text: Marta har bakt en stor kake. Kaken er til Nils. Hun liker å bake.
sentences.english: Marta has baked a big cake. The cake is for Nils. She likes baking.

sentences.text: Alle kommer til Marta. Hun er glad.
sentences.english: Everyone comes to Marta's. She is happy.

sentences.text: Sam er gjest. Anna og Lars er gjester også.
sentences.english: Sam is a guest. Anna and Lars are guests too.

sentences.text: Marta liker å ha besøk. Hun er glad.
sentences.english: Marta likes having visitors. She is happy.

sentences.text: Gratulerer med dagen, Nils! Her er en gave.
sentences.english: Happy birthday, Nils! Here is a gift.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Takk for gaven, Sam!
sentences.english: Thank you for the gift, Sam!
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Nils tar den. Det er en bok.
sentences.english: Nils takes it. It is a book.

sentences.text: Jeg liker bøker. Jeg vil lese den hver dag.
sentences.english: I like books. I want to read it every day.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Hei, Nils! Du er elleve år nå.
sentences.english: Hi, Nils! You are eleven now.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Gratulerer med bursdagen! Du er en bra elev.
sentences.english: Happy birthday! You are a good pupil.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Her er jakka fra meg.
sentences.english: Here is the jacket from me.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Takk, bestemor! Jeg trenger en jakke.
sentences.english: Thank you, grandmother! I need a jacket.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Gjestene synger en sang for Nils. Sam synger litt.
sentences.english: The guests sing a song for Nils. Sam sings a little.

sentences.text: Kaken er stor. Alle spiser kake.
sentences.english: The cake is big. Everyone eats cake.

sentences.text: Den er veldig god, Marta!
sentences.english: It is very good, Marta!
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Takk, Sam! Du må komme hver søndag.
sentences.english: Thank you, Sam! You must come every Sunday.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Ja, gjerne! Det er en bra bursdag.
sentences.english: Yes, gladly! It is a good birthday.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Alle sier gratulerer, og Nils er glad. Han har gaven fra Sam, og han har ei jakke. Han er ikke trøtt i dag!
sentences.english: Everyone says congratulations, and Nils is happy. He has the gift from Sam, and he has a jacket. He is not tired today!

sentences.text: Nils tenkte på gaven. Han mistet den ikke, og han husket at Sam var snill.
sentences.english: Nils thought about the gift. He did not lose it, and he remembered that Sam was kind.

sentences.text: Alle har synd, sier Marta. Men Gud tilgir, og det er et håp. Sam takker Gud.
sentences.english: Everyone has sin, says Marta. But God forgives, and there is hope. Sam thanks God.

sentences.text: Sam sender en melding til Nils: «Har du tid på lørdag? Vi skal treffe Marta.»
sentences.english: Sam sends a message to Nils: "Do you have time on Saturday? We are going to meet Marta."

sentences.text: I nord og sør er det fjell, og havet er i vest.
sentences.english: In the north and the south there are mountains, and the sea is in the west.
